marketing.title: Manual test cases, automated.
marketing.subtitle: Specra turns the test cases QA already writes into real, reviewable Playwright code — kept in your own Git repository, run with real evidence, and repaired with a human in the loop.

testcases.title: Test cases first
testcases.body: Author manual cases with steps in your own words — Vietnamese or English — stored in PostgreSQL, ready to be modelled.

rag.title: Retrieval, not guesswork
rag.body: Index a test case and it is chunked, embedded and stored in pgvector. The assistant cites the cases it relied on.

providers.title: No vendor in the code
providers.body: Anthropic, OpenAI and Ollama are all on the classpath. Which one runs is one environment variable.

observability.title: Traceable by default
observability.body: Every response carries a request id and a trace id, and every error is an RFC 9457 problem document.

marketing.footerNote: An early build — the golden path lands milestone by milestone.

dashboard.subtitle: What is in the workspace right now.

projects.title: Projects
projects.body: Create a project and author the manual test cases your automation will grow from.

chat.title: Chat & RAG
chat.body: Streaming answers over SSE, with history in Postgres. Flip on RAG to answer strictly from indexed test cases.
